summary.text: Jeff Barta is a Republican state senator from North Dakota who has represented District 43 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election against Democrat Mary Adams in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career includes work as an athletic trainer and as a business owner.

paragraphs.text: Barta earned a B.S. from the University of North Dakota in 1987 and an M.B.A. from Troy University in 2001.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes working as a partner with Achieve Therapy, LLC, as president of Brace Yourself, Inc., and as an athletic trainer.
He has served on the Golf Classic Committee of Special Olympics North Dakota and as board president of St. Joseph's Social Care & Thrift Store.
Barta won the Republican nomination and the general election for District 43 in 2022 and assumed office on December 1, 2022.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
